title: Asbestos Work Permit
name: Asbestos Work Permit
description: Permit control for planned work involving known asbestos-containing materials, including work classification, licensing / notification, plan of work, RPE, waste and clearance.

fields.label: Asbestos Survey / Register Reference and Revision
Plan of Work / Method Statement Reference

sections.title: CLASSIFICATION, LICENSING AND NOTIFICATION
items: Survey / register information is sufficient for the planned work
ACM condition and fibre-release potential are assessed
Work has been classified as licensable, NNLW or non-licensed
Current HSE licence is verified where licensable work applies
Required notification has been made where applicable
Plan of work covers asbestos and other task risks
Unexpected suspect material triggers stop-work and reassessment

fields.label: HSE Asbestos Licence Number / Expiry (if licensable)

sections.title: WORK AREA AND EXPOSURE CONTROLS
items: Work area is segregated and access controlled
Enclosure / extraction / wetting controls match the plan
Negative-pressure equipment is checked where required
Air movement will not spread fibres to clean areas
Work methods minimise breakage and fibre release
Contaminated equipment can be cleaned before leaving
Emergency arrangements cover control failure and accidental damage

fields.label: Enclosure / Air Management Details and Equipment IDs

sections.title: COMPETENCE, RPE AND DECONTAMINATION
items: Workers and supervisors have suitable asbestos training
RPE selection follows the risk assessment
Tight-fitting RPE users have current face-fit records
RPE is inspected and maintained
Protective clothing prevents contamination spread
Suitable decontamination arrangements are available
Medical surveillance requirements have been checked where applicable

sections.title: AIR MONITORING AND CLEARANCE
items: Air-monitoring requirements are defined
Competent analytical support is appointed where required
Analytical independence is considered for clearance work
Four-stage clearance / reoccupation is completed where required
Area is not released until applicable clearance criteria are met

fields.label: Clearance Requirement
options: Four-stage clearance / Certificate for Reoccupation required
Other clearance defined in plan of work

sections.title: WASTE, AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Asbestos waste is sealed and labelled
Waste route prevents contamination of clean areas
Carrier and facility are authorised for the waste
Consignment documentation is retained
Temporary waste storage is secure
Required clearance evidence is received before hand-back
Asbestos register is updated after work
